description:
Vital Recorder is open with VitalDB Case #6 ('case_0006.vital') loaded. This recording contains physiological data from a general anesthesia surgery.

Your task is to identify the precise moments of Intubation (start of mechanical ventilation) and Extubation (end of ventilation) using the capnography waveform, and add event markers to the recording.

1. Locate the 'Primus/CO2' track (yellow waveform). Scan the beginning of the recording to find where the CO2 waveform changes from a flat line to a continuous square-wave pattern. This is the moment of INTUBATION.
2. Add an event marker named 'INTUBATION' at the start of the first valid CO2 breath.
3. Scan the end of the recording to find where the CO2 waveform stops (returns to flat line/noise). This is the moment of EXTUBATION.
4. Add an event marker named 'EXTUBATION' at the end of the last valid CO2 breath.
5. Save the annotated recording as 'annotated_case.vital' in the 'Documents' folder (C:\Users\Docker\Documents\annotated_case.vital).
